steps.caption: Search has two modes. 'Search everything' finds any record by name.
'Find accounts' finds companies that match a description. Switch to it.
Describe what you want, in plain English.
'Understood' shows how your words became filters: place Kharadi, lease event next year.
Edit filters opens every filter, so you can fine-tune by hand.
Size: minimum and maximum square feet, on chargeable or carpet basis.
Lease event: expiry, notice or break, within a window of N months.
Known contact, recent signals, score bands, and whether a requirement or deal already exists.
Coverage: how many companies matched out of all you can see — so you know what was checked.
Each match shows why it matched: the lease and its dates…
…the contact you know there, and any signal about them.
Open the company to act on it.
From here, plan outreach, prepare a meeting, or compare buildings for them.
